name: Standing A/B tests
purpose: Keeps one test running on the busiest flows.
trigger: inside the welcome series and the abandoned cart flow

steps.text: Tests one thing at a time: send time, subject line, or code against no code.
Keeps the winner, then starts the next test.

needs: Enough sends each week to reach a clear result.
why: Small gains on the busiest flows add up faster than a new flow.
